name: Investor Update Email
description: Writes monthly or quarterly investor update emails with key metrics, highlights, lowlights, asks, and forward outlook in a concise format that maintains investor confidence and engagement. Use when the user needs to update investors, angels, or venture partners on company progress. Do NOT use for board narratives (use `board-update-narrative`), stakeholder updates (use `stakeholder-update`), or fundraising pitch materials (those require a different skill set).
